# EvoMonsters.zip — Sprite Descriptions

Visual ID for each monster from left_1 frame. Each pack holds one evolutionary line of 2-3 stages.

## Pack 01 — Corgi Hound (warrior line)
- ID 001: small corgi puppy, white/tan, no armor.
- ID 002: medium corgi hound, red collar, tan coat.
- ID 003: large corgi warrior, red collar with spikes, armored.

## Pack 02 — Red Dragon
- ID 004: small red lizard/dragon, no wings.
- ID 005: medium red dragon, yellow horns and wings.
- ID 006: large red dragon, yellow horns, full wings spread.

## Pack 03 — Purple Goblin
- ID 007: small purple goblin, big green eyes, red gem.
- ID 008: medium purple goblin warrior, horned shoulder pads.
- ID 009: large purple goblin warrior, full armor with horned helmet.

## Pack 04 — Green Orc / Ape
- ID 010: small green ape/monster, unarmed.
- ID 011: medium green orc, blonde hair, brown loincloth.
- ID 012: large green orc warrior, red armor, gold belt buckle.

## Pack 05 — Purple Demon
- ID 013: small purple demon, yellow horns, small tail.
- ID 014: medium purple demon, larger yellow horns.
- ID 015: large purple demon, big yellow horns, spiked tail.

## Pack 06 — Flame Salamander
- ID 016: small red lizard, orange flame horns/back.
- ID 017: medium red salamander, brighter flames.
- ID 018: large red salamander, full flame mane, big fangs.

## Pack 07 — Black Wolf / Dark Hound
- ID 019: small black wolf pup, red eyes.
- ID 020: large black wolf/warg, red eyes, larger.

## Pack 08 — Green Insect (wasp/fly)
- ID 021: small green insect, cyan wings.
- ID 022: medium green insect, larger cyan wings.
- ID 023: large green insect, full wings, stinger.

## Pack 09 — Blue Ghost
- ID 024: small blue ghost, two pink eyes, soft flame body.
- ID 025: medium blue ghost, larger flame body, fangs visible.

## Pack 10 — Purple Ghost
- ID 026: small purple ghost/blob, blue eye.
- ID 027: medium purple ghost, larger body.

## Pack 11 — Purple Spiked Blob (single creature, 3 stages)
- ID 028: small purple spiked creature, orange belly, two eyes.
- ID 029: medium purple spiked creature, four legs.
- ID 030: large purple spiked creature, gold chest plate.

## Pack 12 — Stone Golem
- ID 031: small stone golem, grey rock body, single red eye.
- ID 032: large stone golem, grey rock, yellow crystal spikes on shoulders.

Review heuristics: “grid does not divide dimensions evenly” means the declared cell width or height leaves a remainder. “Fully transparent frame” means every pixel in a grid frame has zero alpha. “Edge-continuation suspect” compares each frame’s right edge with the next frame’s first three columns and flags repeated rows where the current edge is opaque while the neighbor edge is at least 75% transparent. These warnings are simple review cues, not decisions.
